title: EvidenceClaimLink
description: PROGRAM-006 (ADR-008). The relationship between one EvidenceItem and one Claim. This is the sole input to confidence computation (scripts/trader_intelligence/evidence_confidence.py) -- confidence is always recomputed from the set of links attached to a claim, never edited directly.

linkId.description: Format: LINK|{evidenceId}|{claimId}, hash-truncated the same way as Knowledge Graph edge ids when the raw concatenation would be excessively long.

independenceGroup.description: Populated by the confidence engine (defaults to the evidence item's sourceId) so multiple excerpts from the same source are never double-counted as independent confirmation (ADR-008 / Deliverable 5).
